propertyListingViews.description: Fires when a user views a property listing page, capturing the listing ID, property type, and location.

listing.description: Object containing property listing details including unique ID, geographic location, and residential or commercial type.

property_view_count.description: Fires when a property view count metric is tracked, recording the total number of views and the category (e.g., residential property).

category.description: Object classifying the primary category of the property or content being viewed (e.g., Property).

attributes.description: Object containing numeric attributes for a property event, specifically the cumulative or session view count.

user.description: Object containing user demographic data including age range, gender, and stated interests for audience segmentation.

view_item.description: Fires when a user views a specific property listing detail page, capturing listing verification status, ID, name, and verification timestamp.

product.description: Object representing a real estate listing with verification status, verification timestamp, unique listing ID, and listing name.

add_payment_info.description: Fires when a user selects or adds financing information during a real estate transaction, indicating financing method selection.

generate_lead.description: Fires when a real estate lead is generated or captured with urgency level indicating priority of the inquiry.

Property Inquiry Submission.description: Fires when a user submits an inquiry form for a specific property, capturing the submission action in the Real Estate category.

search.description: Fires when a user performs a property search with criteria such as location, price range, bedrooms, property type, and amenities.

form_start.description: Fires when a user begins interacting with a form such as a mortgage pre-approval application, marking form initiation.
